title: Payload — identity.key_rotated
$comment: One field: the identity being rotated away from is the envelope's `author`. At most one successor ever, and the first one a node observes is the one that holds. additionalProperties is true by design: the versioning rules require that a new optional field survives a node that cannot interpret it, preserved byte-exactly for the digest. Every envelope field name is forbidden here (set to false): the convention that a payload never duplicates the envelope is enforced by the schema, not left to prose.
